sources.entry: Mailu - Simple yet full-featured mail server as a set of Docker images. (Source Code) MIT Docker/Python

summary.one_liner: Mailu is a full-featured mail server packaged as a set of Docker images, covering SMTP, IMAP, webmail, administration, and antispam.
summary.what_it_does: Mailu provides standard email services including IMAP, IMAP+, SMTP, and Submission, with auto-configuration profiles for mail clients. It supports aliases, domain aliases, custom routing, full-text search of email attachments, and BURL-enabled submission. It includes web access through multiple webmails and an administration interface, plus user features such as auto-reply, auto-forward, fetched accounts, managesieve, and OpenPGP key publication through WKD. Security features listed are enforced TLS, DANE, MTA-STS, Let's Encrypt, outgoing DKIM, anti-virus scanning, Snuffleupagus, and blocking of malicious attachments. Antispam features include auto-learn, greylisting, DMARC and SPF checks, and anti-spoofing.
use_cases: self-hosted email server for a domain
running my own mail server with Docker
webmail and admin interface for mail accounts
hosting email for a family or small organization
notable: Delivered as a set of Docker images rather than a single package
Includes IMAP, SMTP, Submission, and multiple webmail options with a built-in admin interface
Antispam with greylisting, DMARC, SPF, and auto-learn
Passkey sign-in to Webmail and per-domain admin delegation
Built only from free software components with no tracker included
caveats: Running a mail server requires DNS and TLS setup, which the README does not detail here
Installation instructions are not included in the README; it points to an external website for documentation
